values.en: A based continuous map $\varphi\colon(X,x_0)\to(Y,y_0)$ induces the **induced homomorphism** $\varphi_*\colon\pi_1(X,x_0)\to\pi_1(Y,y_0)$ by $\varphi_*[f]=[\varphi f]$. It satisfies $(\varphi\psi)_*=\varphi_*\psi_*$ and $\mathbb{1}_*=\mathbb{1}$, which makes $\pi_1$ a functor (Hatcher p. 34).
values.zh-CN: 保持基点的连续映射 $\varphi\colon(X,x_0)\to(Y,y_0)$ 由 $\varphi_*[f]=[\varphi f]$ 诱导**诱导同态** $\varphi_*\colon\pi_1(X,x_0)\to\pi_1(Y,y_0)$。它满足 $(\varphi\psi)_*=\varphi_*\psi_*$ 与 $\mathbb{1}_*=\mathbb{1}$，这使 $\pi_1$ 成为函子（Hatcher 第 34 页）。
